newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F J Benjamin says placement shares fully taken up.
newsitem.headline: F J Benjamin says placement shares fully taken up.

text.p: International brands fashion retailer and distributor F J Benjamin Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that its 10 million placement shares offered in its initial public offer (IPO) has been full taken up.

"We are pleased to inform you that 10 million placement shares have been fully subscribed," Frank Benjamin, president and chief executive officer told reporters during his presentation of F J Benjamin's IPO.
F J Benjamin today launched a 50 million share offer priced at Singapore S$0.80 each, of which 10 million shares were placed to institutions and the rest to the public.

The offer will raise net proceeds of about S$37 million to reduce bank borrowings, for overseas expansion and investment and for working capital. The shares will be listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
